prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-02):
Price action as of 2026-04-02: 1w +0.9%, 1m -3.1%, 3m -29.3%. Last close 187.18. 21d annualized realized volatility 38%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 10% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has posted a sharp multi-month decline and sits near the bottom of its recent trading range, but the 1-week price action has turned mildly positive while realized vol remains only moderately elevated. This combination points to a short-term mean-reversion setup over the next 20 trading days rather than continuation of the downtrend.
DECISION: BUY
